from pathlib import Path


def replace(path, old, new, count=1):
    p = Path(path)
    text = p.read_text()
    found = text.count(old)
    if found != count:
        raise SystemExit(f"{path}: expected {count} occurrence(s), found {found}: {old[:100]!r}")
    p.write_text(text.replace(old, new, count))


# Only the prepared reference-transaction phase can veto ref updates. Avoid
# making committed/aborted notifications depend on the configured guard path.
replace(
    ".githooks/reference-transaction",
    '''phase=${1:-}
case "$0" in
  */*) hook_dir=${0%/*} ;;
  *) hook_dir=. ;;
esac
hook_dir=$(CDPATH='' cd -- "$hook_dir" && pwd)
guard_path_file="$hook_dir/glm-parent-action.path"
if [ ! -f "$guard_path_file" ] || [ -L "$guard_path_file" ]; then
  printf '%s\\n' 'publication guard rejected: configured glm-parent-action path unavailable' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! IFS= read -r glm_parent_action <"$guard_path_file"; then
  printf '%s\\n' 'publication guard rejected: configured glm-parent-action path unreadable' >&2
  exit 1
fi
case "$glm_parent_action" in
/*) ;;
*)
  printf '%s\\n' 'publication guard rejected: configured glm-parent-action path is not absolute' >&2
  exit 1
  ;;
esac
if [ ! -x "$glm_parent_action" ]; then
  printf '%s\\n' 'publication guard rejected: configured glm-parent-action is not executable' >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [ "$phase" != prepared ]; then
  exit 0
fi
''',
    '''phase=${1:-}
if [ "$phase" != prepared ]; then
  exit 0
fi

case "$0" in
  */*) hook_dir=${0%/*} ;;
  *) hook_dir=. ;;
esac
hook_dir=$(CDPATH='' cd -- "$hook_dir" && pwd)
guard_path_file="$hook_dir/glm-parent-action.path"
if [ ! -f "$guard_path_file" ] || [ -L "$guard_path_file" ]; then
  printf '%s\\n' 'publication guard rejected: configured glm-parent-action path unavailable' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! IFS= read -r glm_parent_action <"$guard_path_file"; then
  printf '%s\\n' 'publication guard rejected: configured glm-parent-action path unreadable' >&2
  exit 1
fi
case "$glm_parent_action" in
/*) ;;
*)
  printf '%s\\n' 'publication guard rejected: configured glm-parent-action path is not absolute' >&2
  exit 1
  ;;
esac
if [ ! -x "$glm_parent_action" ]; then
  printf '%s\\n' 'publication guard rejected: configured glm-parent-action is not executable' >&2
  exit 1
fi
''',
)

replace(
    "glm-worker/internal/parentactioncmd/publication_git_hook_smoke_test.go",
    "func TestPublicationReferenceTransactionAllowsOrdinaryCommit(t *testing.T) {\n",
    '''func TestPublicationReferenceTransactionNonPreparedPhaseDoesNotRequireGuardPath(t *testing.T) {
\thooks := t.TempDir()
\tcopyPublicationHook(t, "reference-transaction", hooks)
\thook := filepath.Join(hooks, "reference-transaction")
\tfor _, phase := range []string{"committed", "aborted"} {
\t\tcmd := exec.Command("sh", hook, phase)
\t\tif output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
\t\t\tt.Fatalf("reference transaction %s phase required guard path: %v: %s", phase, err, output)
\t\t}
\t}
}

func TestPublicationReferenceTransactionAllowsOrdinaryCommit(t *testing.T) {
''',
)
